title: E-commerce Sales Performance Dashboard

widgets.title: Revenue by Product Category
widgets.insight: Electronics leads with $1,200,000, followed by Fashion ($800,000) and Sports ($600,000).

widgets.title: Top 10 Orders by Total Amount

widgets.title: Distribution of Customer Ratings

ai_summary: The dataset captures 5,000 e-commerce transactions across diverse product categories, with total revenue exceeding $3.3 million. Electronics dominates sales, while customer satisfaction remains high with an average rating of 4.2. Delivery times vary by city, and payment methods show a strong preference for Credit Card.
key_insights: Electronics generated $1,200,000 in revenue, 20% higher than Fashion.
Average discount per order is $5.22, reducing total revenue by 0.8%.
Customers from Istanbul enjoy the fastest delivery, averaging 5.2 days.
The highest single order ($2,265) was a Sports product purchased via Cash on Delivery.
Customer ratings are skewed towards 4-5 stars, with only 2% rating 1 star.
